description: Sibling of proposal-supersession-v1 (1.0.0-alpha.34): identical except that the successor may carry an execution plan v5, which names a trusted-local runtime. Revisions of plans v1-v4 keep writing v1.

plan1.title: Native execution plan v1
plan1.description: Frozen structural contract. Source/digest equality, authority ceilings, scope containment, policy semantics and observed truth require the native semantic validators in addition to this schema.

plan2.title: Design-bound execution plan v2
plan2.description: Additive design-aware plan. Acceptance digest binds both acceptance and design declarations. Source snapshot, permission, capture and byte identity require semantic validation.

plan3.title: Measured-loop and worker-playbook execution plan v3
plan3.description: Additive plan: explicit loop policy, opt-in assertion evidence and one immutable worker-only playbook. Semantic source, applicability, approval and evidence validation is mandatory.

plan4.title: Local-source execution plan v4
plan4.description: Plan v3 unchanged except its repository: a local-only source with no remote, named local://<root commit> by the single root of its history and read only from the Git bundle prepared beside the profile. Hosted sources remain plan v1-v3. Semantic source, bundle, applicability, approval and evidence validation is mandatory.

plan5.title: Trusted-local execution plan v5
plan5.description: Sibling of the measured-loop plan v3 that exists only to name a trusted-local runtime: roles and checks run as ordinary processes on the operator's computer, under the operator's account, each in a fresh temporary clone. Nothing is contained, network cannot be restricted (policy unenforced is the only value), and protected mode refuses it. The source is hosted (https/ssh) or local-only (local://<root commit>). Semantic validation by the native compiler is mandatory.
